name: Social proof stack (reviews → result → offer)

hook.visual: Real review UI or customer face — not stock smile
hook.audio_or_vo: Customer’s strongest sentence, unedited if possible
hook.pattern_interrupt: Lead with proof, not the offer

beats.visual: Cut between review cards, photos, short clips
beats.vo_or_copy: Different proof types: outcome, process, personality

beats.visual: Product/service in use or shop exterior
beats.vo_or_copy: Who it’s for + the primary outcome

beats.visual: Guarantee, process clarity, or ‘what happens next’
beats.vo_or_copy: Remove the biggest objection in one line

cta.spoken_or_caption: Join the [N] people who… / Book your slot
cta.landing_promise: Reviews visible near the form; same proof language

audio_design.music_energy: Warm, steady; don’t overpower customer VO
audio_design.vo_pace: Customer natural; brand VO clear and brief

visual_system.camera: Mix of screen recordings of real reviews + authentic clips
visual_system.lighting: Whatever the customer shot in — authenticity > polish
visual_system.color: Brand accents only on end card

why_it_works: Proof-first lowers skepticism on warm/retarget traffic
Varied proof types cover different objections

prompt_seeds.script: 25s proof-first ad using 3 real review beats, then offer + objection killer. No fake quotes.
prompt_seeds.shot_list: Review1 → Review2 → Result photo → Offer → Risk reversal CTA

source_notes: Bottom-of-funnel pattern; requires real reviews the brand owns rights to use.
